events.title: Japan Retail Sales Gain 2.7% On Year In August
events.description: The value of retail sales in Japan was up 2.7 percent on year in August, the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry said on Wednesday - coming in at 13.052 trillion yen.

events.title: Japan Industrial Output Sinks 1.7% In August
events.description: Industrial production in Japan was down a seasonally adjusted 1.7 percent on month in August, the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry said on Wednesday.

events.title: Singapore Stock Market May Extend Tuesday's Losses
events.description: The Singapore stock market on Tuesday ended the two-day winning streak in which it had risen more than 45 points or 0.8 percent. The Straits Times Index now sits just shy of the 5,715-point plateau and it may spin its wheels again on Wednesday.

events.title: Overbought Malaysia Bourse Called Lower Again On Wednesday
events.description: The Malaysia stock market has moved lower in five straight sessions, slumping more than 40 points or 2.5 percent along the way. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just above the 1,640-point plateau and it's expected to open under pressure again on Wednesday.

events.title: South Korea Industrial Production Falls 4.8% In August
events.description: Industrial output in South Korea slipped a seasonally adjusted 4.8 percent on month in August, Statistics Korea said on Wednesday.

events.title: Japan Stock Market May Open Under Pressure On Wednesday
events.description: The Japan stock market has moved lower in two straight sessions, tumbling almost 900 points or 1.3 percent in that span. The Nikkei 225 now sits just above the 65,480-point plateau and it may take further damage on Wednesday.

events.title: South Korea Industrial Output Sinks 4.8% In August
events.description: Industrial production in South Korea was down a seasonally adjusted 4.8 percent on month in August, Statistics Korea said on Wednesday.

events.title: KOSPI May Spin Its Wheels Again On Wednesday
events.description: The South Korea stock market has finished lower in back-to-back sessions, sinking more than 210 points or 3 percent along the way. The KOSPI now sits just above the 6,870-point plateau and it may remain stuck in neutral again on Wednesday.

events.title: Japan Data On Tap For Wednesday
events.description: Japan will release a raft of data on Wednesday, highlighting a busy day for Asia-Pacific economic activity. On tap are August figures for industrial production, retail sales, construction orders and housing starts.

events.title: Canadian Market Modestly Lower
events.description: The Canadian market remains in negative territory Tuesday afternoon with stocks from energy, communications and healthcare sectors under pressure. Technology stocks are finding some support amid renewed optimism about spending on AI infrastructure.

events.title: Swiss Market Turns Weak In The Final Hour, Ends Marginally Down
events.description: After staying positive till the penultimate hour of the day's session, the Switzerland market faced some resistance and eventually closed on a weak note on Tuesday.

events.title: European Markets Fail To Hold Early Gains, Settle Weak
events.description:
After trading in positive territory for much of the day's trading session, most of the markets in Europe ended weak on Tuesday, hurt by some brisk selling in the final hour. 

Despite oil's retreat, investors turned cautious amid continued uncertainty about Iran and the U.S. reaching an agreement to end their conflict anytime soon.

events.title: U.S. Job Openings Fall More Than Expected In August
events.description: The Labor Department released a report on Tuesday showing job openings in the U.S decreased by more than expected in the month of August.
